atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — registers design tokens (colors, fonts, radii, etc.) in the theme namespace so they generate utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — loads a first-party or JS plugin (e.g. tailwindcss-animate, @tailwindcss/typography).

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — defines a custom variant (e.g. dark) usable with variant utilities.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — defines a custom static utility class that works with variants.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — applies a variant inside plain CSS blocks.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — imports another stylesheet's theme/variables without emitting its CSS, for use with @apply in separate files.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — registers extra content-scanning paths for class detection.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4 — loads a legacy JavaScript config file.
